summary: Describes a security problem with IPv6-in-IPv4 automatic tunnels, where an attacker exploits mismatches between IPv4 and IPv6 routing state to form a routing loop that can amplify traffic for denial-of-service attacks. It explains the root causes and proposes mitigations.

eli5.summary: If two signposts each point to the other, a traveler walks in circles forever. An attacker can create such a loop for internet packets and use it to flood someone. This explains how and how to stop it.

questions: ipv6 automatic tunnel routing loop attack
